header.title: The Soul of Atelier Verdant
header.subtitle: A synthesis of essence, paradox, and binding commitments.

body_sections.heading: Opening
body_sections.prose: Atelier Verdant is a workshop before it is a brand. The work begins with hand-cut linen and ends with a folded note slid inside the box. Everything between those two moments is the brand's argument with the market.
body_sections.pull_quote: A workshop before it is a brand.

body_sections.heading: Essence
body_sections.prose: The essence is **the dignity of slow work**. Each piece carries the trace of a hand. The brand is the refusal of speed.

body_sections.heading: Paradox
body_sections.prose: Atelier Verdant must grow without scaling. The productive tension is in selling rarity at higher unit value, rather than abundance at lower margin.

body_sections.heading: Manifesto
body_sections.prose: We work in materials that age. We work in hours that cannot be compressed. We show the maker, the workshop, the day. We refuse the discount channel. We refuse the algorithm's pace.

always: Name the maker on every piece.
Photograph the workshop, not the model.
never: Sell through marketplaces that hide the maker.
